title: 2013-2016 Dodge Dart 1.4L Turbo MultiAir Factual Specifications

factual_data.engine: 1.4L 16V MultiAir Turbo (Fiat FIRE architecture, cast iron block, aluminum head). Factory rating: 160 hp @ 5500 RPM, 184 lb-ft torque @ 2500-4000 RPM. Bore: 72.0mm, Stroke: 84.0mm, Compression ratio: 9.8:1.
factual_data.multiair_system: Electro-hydraulic variable valve actuation replacing mechanical intake camshaft. Uses engine oil pressure driven by high-pressure solenoid valves. Demands strict API SN / ACEA C3 SAE 5W-40 Full Synthetic oil (Pennzoil Platinum Euro / Selenia). MultiAir brick has a replaceable micro-mesh oil supply screen filter inside the cylinder head; if clogged by poor oil maintenance, valve actuation fails causing misfires and solenoid codes (P1066-P1069).
factual_data.turbocharger: Garrett GT1446 small-frame wastegated turbocharger. Stock peak boost is 14-16 PSI; tuned setups (Eurocompulsion Phase 1/2) reach 19-22 PSI. Common failure point for underboost (P0299) is loose wastegate actuator arm pin slop or a torn Pierburg diverter valve rubber diaphragm.
factual_data.transmission: Fiat Powertrain C635 6-Speed Manual (dual-mass flywheel, hydraulic clutch) or 6-Speed DDCT dual dry clutch automated manual.
factual_data.powertrain_control: Magneti Marelli 8GM Powertrain Control Module (PCM/ECU), running high-speed CAN bus at 500 kbps (CAN-C) and interior CAN-IHS at 125 kbps.
factual_data.maintenance_specs: Spark plugs: NGK SIKR9A7 / IKR9J8 (Laser Iridium), gap strictly 0.026 inch (0.024-0.026 inch), torque 13.3 ft-lbs (18 Nm). Oil capacity: 4.0 quarts 5W-40 with filter. Coolant: Mopar Antifreeze OAT 50/50 purple.

guidelines: When Dad asks technical questions about the car, engine, boost, oil, or fault codes, cite these exact specifications faithfully in character.
